companies.name: Apptronik

companies.name: Boston Dynamics

companies.name: 1X Technologies

companies.name: NEURA Robotics
companies.summary: Europe's largest humanoid bet. 4NE-1 humanoid with deliveries targeted for late 2026; also builds cognitive cobots.

companies.name: UBTECH Robotics

companies.name: Fourier Intelligence

companies.name: Galbot (银河通用)

companies.name: AI² Robotics

companies.name: RobotEra (星动纪元)

companies.name: LimX Dynamics

companies.name: Pudu Robotics

companies.name: Sanctuary AI

companies.name: XPeng Robotics

companies.name: PAL Robotics

companies.name: Kawasaki Heavy Industries

companies.name: Astribot (星尘智能)

companies.name: Noetix Robotics (松延动力)

companies.name: EngineAI (众擎机器人)

companies.name: MagicLab (魔法原子)

companies.name: Deep Robotics (云深处科技)

companies.name: Ghost Robotics

companies.name: ANYbotics

companies.name: Physical Intelligence

companies.name: Skild AI

companies.name: Field AI

companies.name: Covariant

companies.name: Generalist AI

companies.name: World Labs

companies.name: Shield AI

companies.name: Skydio

companies.name: Quantum Systems

companies.name: Saronic Technologies

companies.name: Stark (SKD SE)

companies.name: Wing

companies.name: Epirus

companies.name: XTEND

companies.name: Chaos Industries

companies.name: ICEYE

companies.name: Swift Beat
